question: Who authored the book Memories and Milestones, documenting 60 years of Blue Cross of India, launched in 2025?

options.text: Maneka Sanjay Gandhi and AL Somayaji
Justice PN Prakash and V Sriram

solution:
The correct answer is __**V Sriram and Lashman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The book **"Memories and Milestones"**, which documents the 60 years of the **Blue Cross of India**, was authored by **V Sriram and Lashman**. This highlights their commitment to animal welfare and their association with the organization.
 
• The **Blue Cross of India** is one of the oldest and most prominent animal welfare organizations in India, headquartered in **Chennai**. It was established in **1959** by Captain V. Sundaram.
 
• The book was launched in **2025** to commemorate the six-decade journey of the organization, documenting its impact on animal rights and welfare in India.
 
• **V Sriram**, an author and historian, is known for his contributions to documenting cultural and historical aspects of India, while **Lashman** is a known advocate for animal welfare.
